# Objective

Implement the experimental public Locus V2 command/tool/persistence surface on
`feature/g9u0-locus-v2-public-surface`.

**PROPOSED FUTURE PROMPT — UNEXECUTED AND NOT AUTHORIZED.**

# Mandatory entry gate

Require G9A3 PASS/author approval, author-approved public Locus spec and Accepted
ADR 0013, green G6–G8 authority, clean approved branch, prompt hash, and composed
PASS. During G9U0 inspect actual GeoGebra command/overload/localization/XML conventions,
evaluate mapped-scalar syntax alternatives, and present the final command surface
for author review; do not treat a G9P example as frozen syntax.

# Hard dependencies

Author-approved G9A3 lifecycle/persistence support, the approved public Locus
contract, and frozen G6–G8 semantic authority are hard dependencies. G9X1,
G9U1, G9B and G9O1 are not semantic entry conditions.

# Recommended execution predecessor

Execute after G9A3 and preferably after G9O1 so the public surface is developed
with reproducible context. This recommendation creates no O1-to-U0 semantic
edge.

# Global/release gate

G9U0 is a productive input to G9U1 and the global G9 closeout. Its author
approval does not by itself authorize DXF, a workspace, G9B or U2.

# Authority and evidence hierarchy

Read current command dispatcher/processors, `CmdLocus`/`CmdLength`/`CmdIntersect`,
controllers, G6–G8 source/tests, XML/copy lifecycle and approved G9U0 contracts.

# Scope

Implement a reconstructible typed one-dimensional semantic-generator surface
with exactly one explicit true coordinate/domain. Initial closed state families
cover scalar maps (`u=s`, or explicit `t=f(s)` without mutating dependent `t`)
and semantic support points on a finite segment, circle, oriented circular arc,
or one explicit Locus V2 branch/component. Add experimental Locus V2 creation,
rich total/partial length, the guarded standard total `Length[GeoLocusV2]`
adapter, general Intersect integration, exact-token result
selection and derived points, persistence/copy/undo, flags, help, localization,
icons and diagnostics.

# Explicitly forbidden scope

Do not redirect legacy `Locus`, use sample-index/proximity identity, expose
arbitrary unsupported drivers, infer roots, make V2 generic `Path`, implement
G9 workspaces/DXF/spatial primitives, or silently enable in Classic.

# Editable boundaries

Minimum shared command/algorithm/XML seams, GeoCeDG frontend controller/actions/
resources, tests/models, feature manifest, docs/evidence/verifier and registered
upstream edits.

# Productive versus test-private permissions

Only approved commands/drivers/results are productive and experimental. Analytic
fixtures/factories remain test-private and cannot be exposed as user evaluators.

# Architectural placement

Semantic evaluation/results/token points live in the shared kernel DAG; product
creation modes, feature gates, help and inspection live in GeoCeDG frontend.

# Required design/specification

Preserve rich G7/G8 statuses, Option B admissibility, exact token lineage,
atomic publication, deterministic budgets and separately gated scalar adapters.
Separate durable preimage address (provider/version/branch/canonical parameter/
periodic lift or seam) from revision binding and continuation state. Evaluate
the public syntax against actual GeoGebra command/overload conventions; the
chosen surface must expose an unambiguous typed generator, or the dependent
parameter, its true driver and domain explicitly, and must be presented for
author review. Never infer one ancestor among several.
Use normal construction-DAG inputs for all dependencies and treat evaluation-
session re-entry detection only as defense in depth. The standard total scalar
`Length[GeoLocusV2]` adapter is required and may publish only when the
authoritative rich metric result declares scalar admissibility; otherwise it is
undefined or uses repository-consistent typed failure behavior. Legacy
`Length[GeoLocus]` is unchanged.

# Geometric invariants and degeneracies

Branches, canonical parameters, invalid gaps, tangent/overlap/mixed/incomplete/
stale/work-limit states stay explicit. Graphical proximity may select only among
already established tokens and never becomes durable identity.

# Compatibility and serialization

Legacy commands/files are byte/semantic compatible. V2 and rich objects must
save/reopen/copy/undo deterministically before public creation is enabled.
The GeoCeDG Classic diagnostic path keeps V2/rich objects native, preserves
semantic IDs/tokens/bindings, and uses the same kernel on load/recompute/save/
reopen while creation is disabled. External upstream open is not guaranteed
when the distribution lacks the persisted types; characterize it explicitly
and never add silent legacy-locus or coordinate/list downgrade.

# Required tests and commands

The generator suite must explicitly plan all 22 cases: (1) bounded scalar
slider independent of visibility, (2) free scalar with explicit domain,
(3) dependent `t=f(s)` without mutation, (4) non-injective/periodic/discontinuous
scalar maps, (5) point on segment, (6) point on circle, (7) point on circular
arc, (8) point on an explicit Locus V2 branch/component, (9) Locus V2 -> point
-> Locus V2, (10) nested Locus V2 depth greater than one, (11) self-intersection
with two semantic preimages at one coordinate, (12) disconnected components,
(13) branch loss, (14) periodic seam traversal, (15) split/merge continuation
ambiguity, (16) direct cycle rejection, (17) indirect cycle rejection,
(18) save/reopen, (19) copy within/across constructions, (20) undo/redo,
(21) deterministic nested-query counters and work bounds, and (22) zero render/
sample/viewport authority. Also cover command syntax/types/flags, every G8 rich
result, guarded scalar Length including every inadmissible case, general
Intersect/token-point separation, old files, GeoCeDG Classic native round trips,
external-upstream unsupported-open/no-downgrade fixtures, tool selection/help/
localization/icons and functional counters.
Run focused G9U0 plus composed verification without `-SkipBuild`.

# Required artifacts

Source/tests/models/resources, migration evidence, API/user docs, traceability,
focused verifier, machine evidence and report.

# Stop conditions

Stop if dependent evaluation is not reconstructible, public objects cannot
persist, general Intersect loses legacy behavior, or token identity needs
proximity/index/order. Also stop if the real driver is inferred, dependent
parameters are mutated, periodic/component continuation is heuristic, or a
cycle is hidden outside the normal construction DAG.
